rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Central Election Authority's declaration dated 19 October 2022 states that Mallikarjun Kharge and Shashi Tharoor were the candidates and that polling was held on 17 October 2022.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same declaration states that counting took place on 19 October 2022 in the presence of the candidates' agents: 9,385 votes polled; Mallikarjun Kharge 7,897, Shashi Tharoor 1,072, invalid 416.

rows.text: Madhusudan Mistry, Returning Officer, Election of Congress President, declares under Article XVIII(d) of the party constitution that the candidate (printed 'Shri Mallikajun Kharge' in this sentence) is elected President of Indian National Congress.
